string.text: The Draco pistol is a compact, Romanian-made firearm based on the AK-47 design, chambered in 7.62x39mm. Despite its short barrel (typically around 10 inches or less), it retains the power and reliability of its full-sized counterpart, making it popular for home defense, truck guns, and tactical applications. Lacking a stock, the Draco is classified as a pistol under U.S. law, though many users add braces or convert them into short-barreled rifles (SBRs) with proper registration. Its loud report, bright muzzle flash, and high-energy rounds make it an intimidating weapon, often featured in movies and pop culture.\n This is the smaller Micro Draco model, painted in a somewhat curious choice of colors.\n
